asset_dimensions.name: asset_dimensions
asset_dimensions.value: "asset"."bytes" >= 0 and ("asset"."width" is null or "asset"."width" > 0) and ("asset"."height" is null or "asset"."height" > 0)

outbox_payload.name: outbox_payload
outbox_payload.value: ("contact_outbox"."payload" is null or json_valid("contact_outbox"."payload")) and ("contact_outbox"."status" not in ('sent','failed') or "contact_outbox"."payload" is null)

github_grant_cleanup_token.name: github_grant_cleanup_token
github_grant_cleanup_token.value: ("github_grant"."state" not in ('pending','inflight','uncertain')) or ("github_grant"."token_enc" is not null and "github_grant"."token_binding" is not null)

save_attempt_draft.name: save_attempt_draft
save_attempt_draft.value: "owner_save_attempt"."draft" is null or (json_valid("owner_save_attempt"."draft") and length(cast("owner_save_attempt"."draft" as blob)) <= 1048576)

save_piece_data.name: save_piece_data
save_piece_data.value: json_valid("owner_save_piece"."data") and json_type("owner_save_piece"."data") = 'text' and length(cast("owner_save_piece"."data" as blob)) <= 4096
